description: Frozen gate-level programs for the 31 points of Fe2S2 Figure 1(a), including the released reference.
boundary: Pinned 41052-term alias decision, SELECT and unlookup; 40 system, 16 index and 16 coin qubits. Uniform state preparation, reflection, QPE and an additional external control are excluded.
resource_convention: CCX + CCZ count as native Toffoli equivalents. Outcome-conditioned Clifford gates remain Clifford. Space includes all 40 system qubits. Product = Toffoli count times peak total logical qubits, not depth or runtime.

recorded_validation.all_row_scope: Two Fock-state samples per row; complete circuit uses keep-1 and keep alias boundary inputs (keep=0 uses 0 twice).
